EQUIPMENT

Compare the platforms.

Inspection, reach, contact cleaning, sediment removal and surface cleaning each call for a different configuration.

19 platforms

Portable inspection ROV

R-20 / R-20Li

A compact 16 kg observation ROV with a tethered power supply (R-20) or an internal lithium battery (R-20Li), for fast visual checks where vehicle size and handling matter.

View equipment
Inspection ROV

R-30

A tethered inspection ROV for visual assessment of submerged structures, with payload and sensor selection matched to the task.

View equipment
Inspection ROV

R-45

A tethered inspection platform with a higher brochure payload than the R-30, for projects needing additional sensing or tooling.

View equipment
Light work-class ROV

R-150

A 195 kg light work-class ROV rated to 500 m, with a 20 kg payload and modular interfaces for sensors and tools on offshore and hydraulic-structure tasks.

View equipment
Work-class ROV

R-400

A 520 kg work-class ROV rated to 800 m, with a 50 kg payload and 12 thrusters for offshore wind foundations, subsea cables and hydropower tasks.

View equipment
Heavy work-class ROV

R-2000

A 2.2 t heavy work-class ROV rated to 1,000 m, supplied with a tether management system and shore control for subsea engineering, survey and recovery tasks.

View equipment
Heavy work-class ROV

R-4000

A 3.3 t heavy work-class ROV rated to 3,000 m with a 200 kg payload and titanium-alloy frame, for deep-water engineering maintenance and resource exploration.

View equipment
Compact crawler inspection robot

A-30

A 35 kg crawler inspection robot that swims, rolls onto a wall and crawls along it, for close inspection of tanks, pools, pipes and structure surfaces to 100 m.

View equipment
Crawler inspection robot

A-400

A 400 kg tracked underwater robot that switches between swimming and crawling on submerged structures, for dam, intake and hydropower inspection to 300 m.

View equipment
Tunnel inspection ROV

AD-400

A specialist platform for long-distance inspection of flooded water tunnels, combining a tethered vehicle with project-specific sensing and tether management.

View equipment
Underwater cleaning robot

A-80

A floating and crawling underwater platform described by the manufacturer for contact cleaning, with cavitation water-jet and brush configurations subject to application review.

View equipment
Underwater dredging robot

AD-100

A remotely operated platform described in the manufacturer brochure for underwater sump dredging, with suction, conveyance and treatment selected together.

View equipment
Unmanned survey vessel

USUG-Skaters

A 4.5 m autonomous catamaran for bathymetry, hydraulic-structure inspection and hydrological monitoring, with modular payload bays and an optional ROV and docking station.

View equipment
Surface cleaning vessel

S-Cleaner

A 2 m, 270 kg autonomous catamaran that detects and collects floating debris in harbours, reservoirs, rivers and scenic waters, using lidar and cameras to avoid obstacles.

View equipment
Large surface cleaning vessel

M-Cleaner

A 5 m-class autonomous cleaning vessel with a 500 kg debris capacity for harbours, coastal waters within 2 km of shore, lakes and reservoirs, including algae and floating waste.

View equipment
Ocean observation vessel

USOL10

An 11 m unmanned observation vessel for coastal and offshore monitoring, carrying multibeam, ADCP, CTD and water samplers, with an optional two-person manual mode.

View equipment
Unmanned transport vessel

USTL15

A 15 m unmanned transport vessel with at least 1,000 kg payload for offshore supply runs, equipment sea trials and area patrols.

View equipment
Ocean optical buoy

HY-FB-GX01

A 2 m moored buoy for long-term optical, water-quality and weather observation, designed to stay level in wind and waves.

View equipment
Underwater glider

GL-1300

A buoyancy-driven underwater glider rated beyond 1,300 m, with glide and vertical-profile modes for long-duration ocean observation.
